headline: Rising Japanese Interest Rates Hit Wholesale Sector; 105 Companies Face Profit Test
summary: As the Bank of Japan continues its tight monetary policy, Japan's wholesale sector faces increasing financial pressure. The report says 105 companies face a profit test.
why: The Bank of Japan sets the policy rate that drives borrowing costs across Japan's economy. Wholesalers typically operate on thin margins and carry significant debt, making them sensitive to rate increases.
